title: Magnetic Micro-Interactions & Spring Dock
tagline: Exploring organic cursor magnetism, spring-damper physics, and tactile UI feedback.
description: A modular interaction kit demonstrating physics-based magnetic attraction. Elements calculate distance vectors from the pointer and smoothly pull toward the cursor with natural mass and momentum before springing back to their resting origins.
interactiveDetails: Interactive playground with adjustable tension, friction, and magnetic radius sliders.
highlightMetricOrFeature: High-performance GSAP quickSetter running at native display refresh rates (120Hz ready)
